note: Both sets capture the main equipment ratings (2.8 kW inverter, 50 A/2P main breaker, 60 A DC NFDS, 200 A/2P NFDS, junction box) with supporting quotes. Set B correctly quotes the 60A DC NFDS note for the DC NFDS enclosure claim and additionally extracts the 200A/2P NFDS enclosure type with its own quote. Set A attaches the 200A/2P NFDS quote to the DC NFDS enclosure claim, misbinding the quote to the wrong device. Both sets misstate the sub-panel phase as '3 W' (the note reads 1-phase, 3W).
remarks: Both sets read 'SUB-PANEL PV | phase | 3 W' from '1, 3W': the phase is 1 (1-phase) and 3W is the wire count, so the phase claim is misbound in both. Wiring schedule entries (e.g. 150 AL: 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C.) are only partially extracted (ground conductor and conduit omitted), and the NEC 690.42 exception / ground-fault bonding note is not claimed by either set.
